failing_checks.title: Tenant isolation
failing_checks.reason: The API-key validation cache is keyed only by the raw key and stores the APIKey with no tenant binding. A key validated for one tenant is returned from cache for any request, so the caller is not bound to the tenant of the key. This is the defect already recorded as security-ai-cross-user-access-1.
